mapper.select: SELECT p.property_id, bl.building_purpose AS main_purpose, bl.violation_yn AS violation_building, bl.total_floor_area, bl.exclusive_area, bl.approval_date, bl.data_source, bl.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS collected_at FROM property p LEFT JOIN building_ledger bl ON bl.property_id = p.property_id WHERE p.property_id = #{propertyId}
